```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 6,
  dev = "png",
  dpi = 150
)
```

```{r load}
library(censusindia)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r data}
years <- c(1941, 1951, 1961, 1971, 1981, 1991, 2001, 2011)

pop_geo <- lapply(years, function(y) {
  census_population_time_series |>
    filter(geography == "state", year == y) |>
    attach_geometry(year = y, geography = "state")
}) |> bind_rows()
```

```{r facet-map}
pop_geo |>
  mutate(population_millions = population / 1e6) |>
  plot_map("population_millions",
    legend_title = "Million", facet = "year", base_layer = FALSE,
    unit_boundary_color = "white", legend_position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r growth}
growth_years <- c(1951, 1961, 1971, 1981, 1991, 2001, 2011)

pop <- census_population_time_series |>
  census_years() |>
  filter(geography == "state") |>
  arrange(state_name_harmonized, year)

growth <- pop |>
  group_by(state_name_harmonized) |>
  mutate(growth_rate = percent_change(population, lag(population))) |>
  filter(!is.na(growth_rate), year %in% growth_years) |>
  ungroup()

growth_geo <- lapply(growth_years, function(y) {
  growth |>
    filter(year == y) |>
    attach_geometry(year = y, geography = "state")
}) |> bind_rows()
```

```{r growth-map}
plot_map(growth_geo, "growth_rate",
  palette = "blue_red", limits = c(-10, 50), legend_title = "Growth %",
  facet = "year", base_layer = FALSE, unit_boundary_color = "white", legend_position = "bottom"
)
```
